title: sophora gibbosa
intro: Sophora gibbosa, commonly known as the "Yellow Sophora" or "Yuan Huang", is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Sophora gibbosa include improving cardiovascular health, reducing oxidative stress, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties are believed to include isoflavones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and anti-viral activities.
